     6	# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal

     8	# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
     9	# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.

    12	#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)

    14	#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
    15	#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
    16	#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
    17	#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
    18	#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)

    21	#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
    22	#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
    23	#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
    24	#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
    25	#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
    26	#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
    27	#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
    28	#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
    29	#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
    30	#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
    31	#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.

    33	#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
    34	#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
    35	#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
    36	#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
    37	#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
    38	#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
    39	#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
    40	#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
    41	#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
    42	#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
    43	#                              is lost with the subshell
    44	#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
    45	#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
    46	#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
    47	#
    48	# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
    49	# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
    50	# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
    51	# =============================================================================
    52	
    53	usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }

    55	json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
    56	
    57	# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
    58	# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
    59	# by mentioning a network error).
    60	ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'
    61	
    62	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
    63	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
    64	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    65	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
    66	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
    67	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
    68	  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    69	  return 1
    70	}
    71	
    72	is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
    73	  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
    74	  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
    75	  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
    76	                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
    77	           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    78	  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
    79	  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    80	    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
    81	  fi
    82	  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
    83	  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    84	    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
    85	                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
    86	                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
    87	                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
    88	                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
    89	  fi
    90	  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
    91	  return 1
    92	}
    93	
    94	# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
    95	EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
    96	_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
    97	  local i
    98	  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    99	    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
   100	  else
   101	    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
   102	  fi
   103	  echo -1
   104	}
   105	est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
   106	  local i
   107	  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
   108	  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
   109	  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
   110	  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
   111	  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
   112	  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
   113	}
   114	est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
   115	est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
   116	  local i p
   117	  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
   118	  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
   119	    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
   120	  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
   121	    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
   122	  else est_hint "$1"; fi
   123	}
   124	
   125	spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
   126	  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
   127	  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
   128	  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
   129	    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
   130	    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
   131	    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
   132	    CHARGED_COST=0
   133	  else
   134	    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
   135	    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
   136	  fi
   137	}
   138	
   139	budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
   140	  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
   141	  while true; do
   142	    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
   143	    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
   144	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
   145	      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
   146	        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
   147	        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
   148	          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
   149	      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
   150	      return 1
   151	    fi
   152	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
   153	      reap "$inflight"; continue
   154	    fi
   155	    return 0
   156	  done
   157	}

    76	                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
    77	           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"

    80	    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
    81	  fi

    84	    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
    85	                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
    86	                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
    87	                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
    88	                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
    89	  fi

    95	EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
    96	_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
    97	  local i
    98	  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    99	    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
   100	  else
   101	    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
   102	  fi
   103	  echo -1
   104	}
   105	est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
   106	  local i
   107	  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
   108	  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
   109	  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
   110	  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
   111	  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
   112	  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
   113	}
   114	est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
   115	est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
   116	  local i p
   117	  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
   118	  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
   119	    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
   120	  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
   121	    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
   122	  else est_hint "$1"; fi
   123	}
   124	
   125	spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
   126	  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
   127	  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
   128	  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
   129	    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
   130	    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
   131	    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
   132	    CHARGED_COST=0
   133	  else
   134	    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
   135	    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
   136	  fi
   137	}
   138	
   139	budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
   140	  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
   141	  while true; do
   142	    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
   143	    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
   144	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
   145	      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
   146	        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
   147	        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
   148	          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
   149	      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
   150	      return 1
   151	    fi
   152	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
   153	      reap "$inflight"; continue
   154	    fi
   155	    return 0
   156	  done
   157	}

collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>

  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then

    set_state failed; exit 3
  fi
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
    local cost st
    cost="$(jq -r '(.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    else
      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    fi
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  else
    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"

  write_status
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
     4	# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
     5	# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
     6	#
     7	# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
     8	# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
     9	# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
    10	# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
    14	#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
    15	#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
    16	#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
    17	#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
    18	#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
    19	#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
    20	#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
    21	#                   [--docker-bin D]
    22	#
    23	# Options:
    24	#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
    25	#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
    26	#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
    27	#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
    28	#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
    29	#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
    30	#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
    31	#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
    32	#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
    33	#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
    34	#   --run-cap USD        per-run cap passed to pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd and reserved per
    35	#                        running trial (default evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    36	#                        else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12)
    37	#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
    38	#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
    39	#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
    40	#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
    41	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke
    42	#                        evals/results/ablation-2.0)
    43	#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
    44	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
    45	#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
    46	#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
    47	#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    48	#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
    49	#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    50	#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
    51	#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
    52	#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
    53	#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
    54	#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
    55	#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
    56	#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
    57	#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
    58	#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
    59	#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
    60	#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
    61	#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
    62	#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
    63	#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
    64	#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
    65	#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
    66	#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
    67	#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
    68	#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
    69	#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
    70	#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
    71	#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
    72	#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
    73	#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
    74	#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
    75	#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
    76	#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
    77	#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
    78	#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
    79	#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
    80	#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
    81	#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
    82	#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
    83	#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
    84	#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
    85	#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no

   118	# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
   119	# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
   120	# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
   121	#
   122	# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
   123	#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
   124	#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
   125	#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
   126	#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
   127	#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
   128	#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
   129	#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
   130	#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
   131	#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
   132	#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
   133	#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
   134	#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
   135	#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
   136	#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
   137	#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
   138	#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
   139	#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
   140	#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
   141	#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
   142	#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
   143	#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
   144	#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
   145	#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
   146	#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
   147	#      fails the batch once the running trials end
   148	#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
   149	#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
   150	#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
   151	#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
   152	#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
   153	#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
   154	#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
   155	#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
   156	#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
   157	#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
   158	#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
   159	#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
   160	#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
   161	#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
   162	#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
   163	#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
   164	#
   165	# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
   166	#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
   167	#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
   168	#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
   169	#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
   170	#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
   171	#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
   172	#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
   173	#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
   174	#   reported cost.
   175	#
   176	# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
   177	#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
   178	#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
   179	#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
   180	#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
   181	#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
   182	#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
   183	#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
   184	#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
   185	#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
   186	#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
   187	#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
   188	#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
   189	#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
   190	#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   191	#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
   192	#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
   193	#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
   194	#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
   195	#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
   196	#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
   197	#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
   198	#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
   199	#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
   200	#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
   201	#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
   202	#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
   203	#
   204	# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
   205	#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
   206	#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
   207	#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
   208	#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and
   209	#   --rerow need --resume (order: --clear-drift, --rerow and --rerun are checked before the lock,
   210	#   then --rerow replaces rows, then the counters are recomputed with the rerun-flagged rows left
   211	#   out of the done set; the reruns are dispatched with the plan). A resume clears STATUS.json
   212	#   outage (kept under outage_history[]). A start

   214	#   earlier driver (one killed with SIGKILL) is still alive.
   215	#
   216	# Exit: 0 complete (every trial rowed; none transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   217	#       interrupted or contaminated), 1 partial (cut, the outage breaker, a paused arm with trials left, an
   218	#       excluded row, or the driver was signalled), 2 usage or refused, 3 failed (drift, an
   219	#       invalid or duplicated row, no trial completed without a cut, or every arm of the
   220	#       plan paused)
   221	#
   222	# Env: LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE, LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO, LOA_ABLATION_CACHE,
   223	#   LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S,

   228	# =============================================================================

   511	    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}

   519	    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
   520	    if not mu or not want: continue
   521	    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
   522	        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
   523	        continue

   764	run_dir_of() {  # run_dir_of <run_id> → <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n> or its highest -r<k> sibling; empty when none

   772	    k="${d##*-r}"; [[ "$k" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
     4	#
     5	# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
     6	# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
     7	# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
     8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
     9	# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
    10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
    14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
    15	#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
    16	#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
    17	#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
    18	#
    19	# Options:
    20	#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
    21	#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
    22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
    23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
    24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
    25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
    26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
    27	#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
    28	#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
    29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
    30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
    31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
    32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,

   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
   183	    if n == 0:
   184	        return None
   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
   188	    frac = pos - lo
   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
   193	    if not diffs:
   194	        return None, None
   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   196	    n = len(diffs)
   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)

   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:

   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
   183	    if n == 0:
   184	        return None
   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
   188	    frac = pos - lo
   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
   193	    if not diffs:
   194	        return None, None
   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   196	    n = len(diffs)
   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)

   202	def mde(diffs, level):
   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
   204	        return None
   205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
   206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
   207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

   210	def collapse(run_ids):
   211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
   212	    groups, other = {}, []

   215	        if m:

   220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
   221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))

   223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
   224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
   225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
   226	        else:
   227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))

   566	    def deltas(self, comps):
   567	        """c and w over the per-task means of the cells the primaries paired."""
   568	        per_task = {}
   569	        for comp in comps:
   570	            for p in comp["pairs"]:
   571	                per_task.setdefault(p["task_id"], p)
   572	        if not per_task:
   573	            return None, None, 0
   574	        ps = [per_task[t] for t in sorted(per_task)]
   575	
   576	        def delta(a, c):
   577	            ma, mc = mean([p[a] for p in ps]), mean([p[c] for p in ps])
   578	            return None if not mc else (ma - mc) / mc * 100.0
   579	
   580	        return delta("arm_cost", "control_cost"), delta("arm_wall", "control_wall"), len(ps)

   582	    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
   583	        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
   584	        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
   585	        P = [p for p in comps if p["n"] > 0]
   586	        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
   587	        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
   588	        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
   589	            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
   590	            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
   591	            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
   592	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
   593	        if hits:
   594	            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   595	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
   596	        if hits:
   597	            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   598	        clauses = []
   599	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
   600	        if hits:
   601	            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")
   602	        if nopair:
   603	            clauses.append("no valid pair (" + ", ".join(name(p) for p in comps if p["n"] == 0) + ")")
   604	        if clauses:
   605	            return "inconclusive", "inconclusive: " + "; ".join(clauses), clauses
   606	        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)
   607	        if all(r9(p["d"]) >= -T for p in comps) and cost_ok:
   608	            which = []
   609	            if c is not None and r9(c) <= -C:
   610	                which.append(f"c = {c:+.1f}")
   611	            if w is not None and r9(w) <= -C:
   612	                which.append(f"w = {w:+.1f}")
   613	            return "remove", (f"remove: every applicable primary has d >= -{T:g} and "
   614	                              f"(c <= -{C:g} or w <= -{C:g}) ({', '.join(which)})"), []
   615	        return "simplify", f"simplify: every applicable primary within -{T:g}, cost similar", []

   617	    def arm_report(self, arm, cuts, seed):
   618	        prims = self.primaries(arm)
   619	        comps = [self.compare(arm, CONTROL, m, seed) for m in prims]

   621	        share, ex, seen = self.excluded_share(arm)
   622	        out = {"arm": arm, "arm_label": self.arms[arm].get("label", arm), "primaries": prims,
   623	               "comparisons": comps, "c": c, "w": w, "cost_tasks": n_cost,
   624	               "excluded_share": share, "excluded_cells": ex, "cells_seen": seen}
   625	        if not seen:
   626	            state, rule, clauses = "no_rows", "no rows for this arm", []
   627	        else:
   628	            state, rule, clauses = self.decide(arm, comps, c, w, share)
   629	        out["predicate_state"] = state
   630	        out["predicate_rule"] = rule

   632	        if state == "inconclusive" and any(cl.startswith("excluded share") for cl in clauses):

   387	        self.cells = {}         # (arm, task) -> {trial: {"valid": row|None, "rows": [...]}}
   388	        self.task_type = {}

   392	            seeded = row.get("defects_seeded")

   394	                self.task_defects[row["task_id"]] = max(self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0), seeded)

   403	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, f"duplicate cell; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}",

   406	                        sup = f"; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}" if cell["valid"] else ""
   407	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, x["_reason"] + sup, counted=not cell["valid"]))

   425	    def _classify(self, row, mans):
   426	        arm, task, ttype = row["arm"], row["task_id"], row["task_type"]
   427	        m = mans.get(row["batch"])
   428	        if m is None:

Prose in written heredocs is already covered by stripping heredocs. The command text outside heredocs should keep the old substring test, or at least a `\bhidden\b` word test.

Absolute paths can legally contain `=`, so `cat /home/other/x=1` now grades clean (base: outside_path). Skip only the `=…` suffix, or only words where `=` comes before the first `/` component.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1423 — Single-component absolute words are now skipped unless the name is root/home/mnt/media/srv. In host mode that whitelist misses the macOS and Linux data roots (`/Users`, `/Volumes`, `/private`, `/data`, `/run`, …), so `cd /Users && cat other/.ssh/id_rsa` no longer raises a candidate. Either derive the list from the outside-roots check or keep flagging one-component words in host mode.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:1071 — append_and_validate appends the job row to the rows file (the tracked runs.jsonl by default) before running `--validate`, and never rolls back. A row that fails validation, or a second row for a run_id, stays in the file. On --resume the reconciliation loop (line 1342) counts that row as done, and a duplicate wedges every later resume at line 1325. The append should be a temp-file + validate + mv under the flock, the same pattern replace_row_try uses.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:625 — When the `claude --version` probe fails or times out, CLI_VERSION silently becomes "unknown" and the batch still starts. drift_check (lines 543-548) then skips the CLI-version comparison because "unknown" is not a semver, and also skips the image-digest fallback because the transcripts do carry a version. The result is no CLI drift guard at all (DEC-0407), and a resume compares "unknown" == "unknown". A non-smoke batch should refuse in pre-flight when the version is unknown.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:1304 — Resume rebuilds spend from rows + ledger_usd only. Assumed run-cap charges and the real spend of trials that ended without a row (no result at line 1121, no row at line 1159, pipelines killed by a driver signal) are dropped. Those trials are then launched again, so --max-usd under-counts what was actually spent on every resume and the budget gate can let the batch overrun the cap. head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:1395 — CUTS_JSON is restored from STATUS.json on resume. head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:564 — The DEC-0435 hard gate counts `: PASS` lines anywhere in the self-check log against 2 × tasks + review-catch, and does not check that each task (and each check) has its own PASS. head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:461 — Cells are keyed by (arm, task, trial number) with no batch. Rows of the same arm/task/trial from two batches collapse into one cell and only the last valid row is used. The earlier valid row is listed as "duplicate cell; superseded" and leaves the analysis. With DEC-0559's planned A0/A1/A4 rerun on suite v2 next to the P1 rows, the report will silently discard data or mix batches. Key cells by batch, or refuse rows from more than one batch per arm unless that is explicitly allowed.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:791 — More than one suite_manifest_sha256 (or source commit or CLI version) across the batches read is only flagged with " — DRIFT" in the header, and the decisions are still computed and printed as final. The pre-registered drift guard (rules.drift_guard) should stop the report (exit 2) or force every decision to inconclusive/partial when the frozen suite differs between the rows compared.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

This PR shouldn't merge: the grader changes make the contamination check easy to get past. The review is in `review.md`: 15 findings and a final line of `Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED`.

**Grader (`ablation-grade.sh`, 1.2.1–1.2.5).** I ran the head and base versions of the path check side by side on the same commands. Five commands that the base grader flags now come back clean:
- `cat /../root/.ssh/id_rsa` and `cat /./root/x` pass, because any word starting with `/.` is now skipped.
- `python3 - <<'PY' … open('/root/secret') … PY` and the same with `bash <<EOF` pass, because heredoc bodies are now removed before the scan, even when the heredoc is code fed to an interpreter.
